# Problem Solving Mind

> Technology Products & Digital Solutions

Problem Solving Mind (PSM) is a technology company that builds proprietary products and delivers digital solutions for businesses and organizations. We start with the problem, not the tech stack.

This is the llms.txt index for problemsolvingmind.com. It lists the pages an LLM or agent is most likely to need. Each linked page contains a full user-friendly HTML view of that content.

- [EYD — Explore Your Dream](https://problemsolvingmind.com/products/eyd) — Real-estate technology with immersive 3D property experiences.
- [Aura](https://problemsolvingmind.com/products/aura) — Healthcare technology and connected-devices initiative.
